findings.summary: The URL-shortener acceptance figures are not recoverable from the repository evidence, so the operator must establish their provenance before they become qualification claims.
findings.evidence: Brief lines 192-194 claim 10 of 10 tasks, all first-pass, about $1.31 and about $8.10 for the Claude comparison. docs/design-notes/copilot-cli-experiments.md has no mai-code-2 section or matching figures, and no matching telemetry exists under .vloop/state/runs or in the B39 run record; the only locally visible $8.10 is B39's eight-task vloop run (docs/briefs/B20261120-1643-b39-local-config-copilot-only.loop-brief.md:520-526), not a 10-task URL-shortener record.
findings.fix: Confirm that the external URL-shortener runs produced these exact totals, then add a repository-local report or cite captured telemetry with enough task, first-pass and cost totals for an offline session to verify; otherwise remove the comparison until that evidence exists.

findings.summary: The B40 and B42 cost descriptions double-count or contradict the persisted telemetry.
findings.evidence: Brief lines 196-200 say B42 was about $3.05 plus about $0.30 for the halted first attempt and that B40 halted with nothing charged. B42's first run reaches exactly $0.30 before the fence halt (.vloop/state/runs/B20261126-1008-b42-i162-fence-reads-pwsh/20261126-112917/run.log:12), while its aggregate run record is $3.05 including both runs (docs/briefs/B20261126-1008-b42-i162-fence-reads-pwsh.loop-brief.md:321-327). B40's errored T4 work record has is_error=true, credits=6.57856 and cost_usd=0.0657856 (.vloop/state/runs/B20261125-2207-b40-i156-mixed-os-pwsh/20261125-230701/sessions/011-work.json:4-9).
findings.fix: State that B42's approximately $3.05 includes its approximately $0.30 aborted acceptance attempt. For B40, preserve 'no attempt charged' but replace 'nothing charged' with the recorded model credit/cost, unless a different persisted source disproves the session record.

findings.summary: Task 1 is required to add a README link to D6's new evidence section, but D6 is scheduled after tasks 1-4, leaving that link broken in several completed iterations.
findings.evidence: D3 requires the mai-code-2 sentence to link the design-note evidence (brief lines 202-203), while the shape puts 'D1 and D3 in README.md' first and D6 fifth (brief lines 276 and 282). The target heading does not exist in docs/design-notes/copilot-cli-experiments.md on the base.
findings.fix: Move D6 before D1/D3, or have task 1 add the evidence section and link together, so every completed task leaves the documentation and its links coherent.

findings.summary: The brief has no path that updates B45's roadmap row, contrary to this repository's mandatory architect hand-off rule.
findings.evidence: .claude/skills/vloop-architect/SKILL.md:18 says to point the roadmap row at the brief at hand-off; the roadmap currently ends at B44 in docs/design-notes/vloop-roadmap-b18-b21.md:51, and the brief excludes all docs/design-notes except D6 (brief line 252) with no B45 roadmap task.
findings.fix: Add the B45 row to the applicable roadmap during hand-off or bring that exact roadmap edit into the brief's scope and gate it; amend the design-notes out-of-scope line accordingly.
